decisions.reason: The low-bed trailer series builds directly on the firm's core trailer design, production and service know-how, so the firm can read market feedback and refine the models in-house, even though the lack of website evidence for 2020-2021 adds some uncertainty.

High covers complement the firm's box and flatbed trailers, use familiar materials and processes, and sell through existing dealer and service channels, so the firm can keep improving them at low risk.
With Product B withdrawn, this box trailer series is now the firm's main line in a segment it knows well, though the possibility of further range consolidation keeps the risk somewhat higher.
